node.title: Re^2: One liner is returning unexpected "1" on the output and I do not understand the mechanism at play.
node.author: perlynewby
node.doctext: Yes, this is what I did not understand that replacing the space to no space would return 1. I went I did a few experiments to solidify my understanding. I spent so much time reading but could not understand the inner workings; I appreciate it so much.
